applicabilityBasis.summary: BRLA is issued as a Brazilian-real payment/settlement token, represented as stable at 1 BRL per BRLA. Current issuer terms define it as fiat-backed digital currency and undertake a minimum 1 BRL exchange per BRLA; the independent reserve report describes 1:1 BRL redemption through token burn for KYC-eligible holders. The issuer financial-education policy names Avenia as the BRLA issuer and describes BRLA payment/transfer uses, rather than an investment or a bank deposit. These token-specific payment and fixed-national-currency repayment facts meet the apparent payment-stablecoin fact pattern in the enacted definition; this is an editorial scope assessment, not an official U.S. approval.

genius.notes: Current issuer terms identify the Brazilian entity at CNPJ 50.224.164/0001-70. Its authority-requisition disclosure explicitly states that BRLA Digital Ltda. is the former name of the same legal person with the same CNPJ; the August 2026 issuer policy expressly names Avenia as BRLA issuer. issuerEntity is therefore corrected from BRLA Digital LTDA (Avenia) to the current exact legal name; the leading issuer word changes from BRLA to AVENIA, not the legal person. The public monthly archive contains January-August 2026 reports. The August 31 reserve/supply report was independently opened and contains a UHY reasonable-assurance opinion signed September 16, 2026. Presence of disclosures/redemption terms/attestations does not establish GENIUS reserve or reporting compliance. No licensingRegulator, primaryFederalRegulator or stateRegulator is asserted without token-issuer-specific regulator evidence, and the prior unsupported broad enforcementStatus negative is removed. No public GENIUS authorization/application/foreign-registration evidence was found in the named review; U.S. issuance/pathway and foreign exception remain unestablished. The issuer GENIUS commentary describes alignment with principles, not an application or registration intention. GENIUS issuer/foreign rules remain pre-effective in the reviewed context. not-yet-restricted refers only to the GENIUS DASP clocks: expected January 18, 2027 foreign-lawful-order conditions and July 18, 2028 broader offer/sale restriction; it is not a finding that U.S. sales are otherwise lawful or allowed by issuer terms.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, this named-source review found no public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or foreign-issuer exception registration for BRLA or its issuer, AVENIA SOCIEDADE PRESTADORA DE SERVICOS DE ATIVOS VIRTUAIS LTDA, formerly BRLA Digital Ltda., CNPJ 50.224.164/0001-70. The Avenia Federal Register hits are an unrelated 2010 Avenia AG merger notice and a 1994 botanical notice, not this issuer. The OCC bank-charter table and NYDFS directory are not exhaustive GENIUS authorization registers, and directory absence does not prove legal ineligibility, noncompliance or absence of a nonpublic filing. No U.S. state pathway is disclosed in the token documents. The SCRC rule establishes a procedure, not an issuer approval. Brazilian regulatory references, reserve assurance and statements of alignment with GENIUS principles do not evidence a U.S. approval or token-specific application intention.
